title: "Monthly briefs"
subtitle: "What changed each month, written by the pipeline from its own stored tables"
listing:
  contents: "20*.md"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: table
  fields: [title, date, description]

---

The first daily run of each month writes a brief for the month before: which series gained a
new reading or were revised, which new readings moved unusually, which earlier flags held or
reversed, how listed prices moved, where each out-of-sample test stands, and on how many days
the pipeline ran. Nobody edits a brief after it is written; the code that writes it is
[`pdi/brief.py`](https://github.com/liumOazed/public-data-intelligence/blob/main/pdi/brief.py).

Briefs start with November 2026, the first month the pipeline ran.
